# Femme Ferments

> Femme Ferments is a nonprofit wine organization in Oregon's Willamette
> Valley. Tagline: "Beauty in the Broken Glass." Mission: 100% of profits
> empower women. We craft small-batch wines from donated fruit and borrowed
> cellar space, powered by volunteers, and reinvest every dollar of profit
> into programs that give women the resources to build something of their
> own.

## Organization

- Name: Femme Ferments
- Type: 501(c)(3)-track nonprofit (fiscally sponsored / in formation), wine industry
- Location: Willamette Valley, Oregon, USA
- Website: https://femmeferments.com/
- Contact: hello@femmeferments.com

## Wines

Femme Ferments produces small-batch wines from grapes donated by partner
vineyards and fermented in donated cellar space.

- Albarino, "Power & Grace" (2024) — crisp acidity, white peach, sea-salt
  minerality, grown in volcanic Willamette soil, finished in stainless steel.
- Pinot Noir, "Hope & Grit" (2024) — grown in the valley's iron-red Jory soil;
  patient and deep.

## How the wine gets made

Donated grapes -> volunteer harvest -> partner cellar (borrowed tank and
press time) -> donated corks and packaging -> bottled wine, sold with 100%
of profit funding women's programs.

## Events

Femme Ferments hosts community tastings and gatherings that introduce new
people to the mission. Check https://femmeferments.com/ for the current
event calendar and ticketing (a Launch Party & First Pour event typically
runs each fall in the Willamette Valley).

## Community & volunteering

Femme Ferments runs entirely on volunteer labor across six roles:

1. The Harvester — picks and sorts donated fruit at partner vineyards each
   harvest season (September–October).
2. The Storyteller — photographs events and writes the community newsletter.
3. The Host — plans and runs tastings and community gatherings.
4. The Builder — contributes design, carpentry, or logistics skills.
5. The Connector — introduces the organization to donors, allies, and press.
6. The Maker — winemakers who guide the winemaking process from crush to
   bottle and mentor volunteers.

Anyone interested in volunteering, partnering (as a vineyard, cellar, or
supplier), or donating can reach the team at hello@femmeferments.com or via
the contact form at https://femmeferments.com/#contact.

## Donating

Donations directly fund women's programs (harvest-shift supplies, community
tastings, hands-on training). See https://femmeferments.com/#donate.

## Site structure

Femme Ferments is a single-page site; all content lives at the root URL with
in-page anchors:

- https://femmeferments.com/ — home (vision, land, wines, mission, community
  roles, events, partners)
- https://femmeferments.com/#wines — wines
- https://femmeferments.com/#community — volunteer roles
- https://femmeferments.com/#events — events
- https://femmeferments.com/#contact — contact form
